services.desc: The Oakville Centre for the Performing Arts is proud to collaborate with our community to provide local theatre, music and culture. Season subscriptions and packages for community performances will be announced as they become available for the upcoming 2026-2027 season. With our traditional season/series subscription model, you will sit in the same seats for each show. Shows are typically on the same day of the week at the same time (some scheduling exceptions may occur). Our theatre packages are granting you unprecedented flexibility! services.desc: Whether you need a 485-seat auditorium or an intimate 120-seat Studio Theatre, we are here to help plan your event from technical set-up and operation to ticketing and box office services to catering.
